how: The four-pixel start is a participant's retrospective individual beginning rather than a documented room decision.
Calls recruit hands repeatedly for repair and defence after a pattern already exists.
An anticipated inability to hold against an incoming flood motivates a backup proposal.
Bare thanks fits the element, although the submission does not establish a call-and-answer pair.
The room works out expansion, accommodation and whether its mark should remain background.
Attention-seeking signs, a redirect name and stamp embellishment make the pattern identifiable.
Participants report growth and the state of a maintained pattern.
Guides and a shared-background template circulate an intended output without proving agreement on it.
Repair consumes available pixels and prompts priorities and repeated manual tending.
Participants explicitly ask to spare neighboring art and make way for it.
Borders and concessions are discussed as reciprocal arrangements with conditions.
Participants call for reclamation and removal, including a speaker's reported effort to erase an unwanted work.
Celebration and collective credit occur during maintenance as well as at the finish.
Recollection, mourning and survivor claims record the effort without requiring a cleaned final image.
Continuation takes the form of challenges, replacement canvases, a new chat and reusable designs.
A script allegation and a personal denial warrant a dispute over machine hands, but local deployment requires independent confirmation.
A visiting participant explicitly reports spare accounts while promising to stop resistance, without establishing host automation.
Visiting spare accounts, disputed scripts and manual tending do not establish that host upkeep pressure caused automation.
Participants request help, report repair, return protection and offer defence for space.
Alliance proposals, joining forces and joint artwork establish cooperation at different levels of commitment.
Candidate hosting is required locally because visitors seek permission to build within the pattern.
Host vetting requires a proposed location before an alliance admitting another work can be advocated.
Admission depends on preserving the host pattern's representation and distinguishing art from simple text.
An approved guest's request to stop damage receives an explanation that holdouts reject the approval.
The host explains continuing damage through placers' refusal to accept an agreement.
Agreement-related restraint depends on placers learning and accepting the agreement rather than approval alone.
Candidate attribution is needed to distinguish planned collaborative recolouring from an apparent attack.
Before repairing apparent damage, helpers need access to the shared plan so they do not erase intended changes.
A participant carries an explicit request to another room to cease expansion.
Prospective alliance discussion and reported cooperation must be distinguished from a completed coalition.
Threat-based joining explains some cooperation, while proactive alliance proposals also occur before acute defence calls.
Reciprocal offers establish stated commitments rather than completed execution of every promised placement.
Defence pressure and offered assistance coexist, but tracing receipt requires more than a request or promise.
Repair and border discussion coexist without showing that erosion caused negotiations rather than expansion or hosting.
Separate design and template posts do not show that publishing the template settled design disagreement.
One room cannot test the population claim, while its approval disputes establish locally consequential permissions.
The absence of demonstrated offices must not erase explicit permissions and disputes over their authority.

statement: Forming a coordinating room around a growing canvas mark
how: The canvas mark can precede and produce its coordinating community rather than simply express an already organised room.
Customising the room's interface is local organising work distinct from a canvas template or a prank takeover.
A redirect and an emergent subreddit do not establish host moderation responding to a canvas-post flood.
The record does not connect recruitment calls to flood-driven containment by a pre-existing host.
Interface customisation alone does not establish an April Fools prank frame.
Colour preferences and joining both colours do not establish a pre-event doctrine or inherited collective identity.
An emergent room and territorial disagreement provide no test of a quarrel carried from before the canvas.
The coded attack-related dispute does not establish a pre-existing tie naming the target.
Mourning and a knowingly late alternate logo do not establish a controversy over preserving a corrected post-event version.
Invitations and future plans demonstrate continuation work without establishing sustained activity on successor venues.
The continuation exchange does not say that preserving an event record caused the decision to continue.
Celebration and recollection both occur, but their presence does not establish the proposed causal ordering.
Growth reports and celebration coexist without tracing a report of completion into a particular collective response.
Reported construction and repeated tending support upkeep without isolating a single build-to-maintenance causal transition.
A retrospective start and later repair call do not trace the starter into recruitment.
A repair call and later tending account do not identify which placements answered that call.
Bare thanks and recruitment are coded without a matching acceptance pair.
Recruitment and attack proposals do not establish recruitment as the cause of attacks.
Attack and restraint positions are present without a coded direct refusal of that attack call.
Attack proposals and truce requests occur without a demonstrated causal link between those concepts.
Internal opposition to concessions and pressure against another work do not by themselves establish reciprocal inter-room taunting.
The coded attack pressure does not establish a subsequent rival-to-rival exchange of taunts or victory claims.
A pre-loss backup proposal and post-event continuation do not demonstrate relocation after the room's work was erased.
Anticipated weakness is not traced into an actual loss-driven move.
